blacklistabilityReview.evidence: The sole registered AUDm deployment is Celo 0x7175504c455076f15c04a2f90a8e352281f492f9; the 2026-10-19 Pharos supply census assigns Celo 100% of circulation, so its controls are material against the 10% threshold. At Celo block 80489704 (2026-10-19T06:14:22Z; hash 0x42bb9d8457a53082b049e0fed7918070b4c9523bc772880c172d4337cf2c9ebf), the EIP-1967 implementation was 0x434563b0604be100f04b7ae485bcafe3c9d8850e and the proxy admin and token owner() were the nonzero Mento Timelock 0x890db8a597940165901372dd7db61c9f246e2147. The proxy exposes owner-gated _setImplementation(address) and _setAndInitializeImplementation(address,bytes). Both proxy and StableTokenV2 runtime matched their verified source bytecode at the pinned block. The Timelock implementation was 0x3efad8f997f705675924470ec84677db68c5a2d0, its runtime matched the verified TimelockController, and getMinDelay() returned 172800 seconds. At the same pinned block, timelock hasRole(PROPOSER_ROLE 0xb09aa5aeb3702cfd50b6b62bc4532604938f21248a27a1d5ca736082b6819cc1, Governor 0x47036d78bb3169b4f5560dd77bf93f4412a59852) returned true; hasRole(EXECUTOR_ROLE 0xd8aa0f3194971a2a116679f7c2090f6939c8d4e01a2a8d7e41d55e5351469e63, address(0)) returned true (open execution). Governor.timelock() returned 0x890db8a597940165901372dd7db61c9f246e2147, closing a live governance scheduling and execution path rather than assuming a nonzero but unusable admin. This admin-upgradeable token is direct Possible even when the administrator is DAO governance and changes wait two days; the DAO-only exclusion applies to collateral, not the token itself. The current StableTokenV2 implementation has ordinary transfer/transferFrom and no blacklist, holder freeze, global transfer pause, seizure, allowlist or arbitrary-holder administrative burn. broker() returned 0x777a8255ca72412f0d706dc03c9d1987306b4cad, validators() 0xaeb865bca93ddc8f47b8e29f40c5399ce34d0c58, and exchange() zero. Permissioned burn(uint256) burns msg.sender only, mint authority increases balances, and debitGasFees(address,uint256) is restricted to the zero-address VM rather than a privileged issuer holder, so these do not establish Yes. Neither variantOf nor mintAuthority.inheritedFrom declares a parent. The issuer reserve API observed 2026-10-19T06:16Z reports collateral.total_usd of $16,826,760.601825558 and asset weights summing to 100%. Against that complete collateral denominator, issuer stablecoins excluding sUSDS alone account for 58.2518%; counting the full 28.0181% sUSDS leg categorically through USDS gives 86.2698%. CELO, stETH and ETH/WETH are excluded from the numerator. This is the issuer collateral.assets denominator, not gross holdings plus separately reported LP/operational portfolios. This ancillary majority does not displace the direct Possible verdict.

oracleRisk.summary: At Celo block 78986505, AUDm's Broker/BiPoolManager USDm/AUDm ConstantSum exchange 0xd580d237231109e6a96d67d82450611c610a805a26660c90281bdc0cd04a95c7 uses AUD/USD feed 0x646bd504c3864ea5b8a6b6d25743721f61864a07, one ChainlinkRelayerV1 reporter 0xa8869bb55d1082d12c8f993a56ce8d050551a3d9, and one configured Chainlink aggregator 0xf2bd4faa89f5a360cdf118bccd183307fdbcb6f5. getRates and medianRate agree on 693160000000000000000000/1e24; medianTimestamp is 1790887224. Effective report expiry and bucket reset are 360 seconds, minimumReports is 1, and spread is 0.15%. MedianDeltaBreaker is enabled at 4% with a 900-second reset cooldown; ValueDeltaBreaker is disabled. Stale reports invalidate ConstantSum quotes; BreakerBox suspends execution rather than substituting a second source. Pre-existing curation correction (not a release downgrade), researched 2026-10-21: the singleton reporter is an immutable, permissionless ChainlinkRelayerV1, not one discretionary data signer. At Celo 80683399 (2026-10-21T12:02:37Z; hash 0x8392666da009829bbb6ccda7f67c4d79210a4ac6eea3666a71a8f247b48d677b), getOracles/getAggregators bind that exact relay to the same AUD/USD proxy and active AccessControlledOffchainAggregator 0x7f3f06cb8cf688403b1bc574768a1e33a2759b64, which exposes ten transmitters. All relay/proxy/DON runtimes exactly match verified explorer bytecode. Verified relay code reads only the immutable feed, validates positive price and timestamp, and permits anyone to relay; verified DON code requires a positive configured threshold, distinct authorized signatures above that threshold and medianized observations. The latest round was 166 seconds old at this pin. Standard-external correctly recognizes the upstream DON; no independent-provider failover or medianized-with-delay credit is asserted. Original October1 review and historical observations are retained, not renewed.

branchApplicability.rationale: AUDm is explicitly reserve-backed in the pinned issuer configuration, not one of the GBPm/CHFm/JPYm CDP assets. The enumerated pinned Broker mint/burn exchange has external price authority but no borrower-specific liquidation engine. Score this authority as coin-price-feed/top-level-only; branch rows and liquidationDelaySec are not applicable. A 900-second breaker reset cooldown or 360-second report expiry is not a liquidation delay. This review covers canonical Celo exchange pricing and does not classify separate bridge control or remote-chain liquidity.
